simplicity.evaluation: Excellent - Each lesson maintains ONE clear goal focused on reflection, portfolios, celebration, or future planning. Three decision points consistently address emotional and practical considerations. Structure is clear and substitute-friendly.

progression.evaluation: Outstanding - Perfect logical progression from memory activation to reflection to portfolio creation to celebration to future planning. Each lesson explicitly builds on the previous, creating a meaningful closure journey.

authenticity.evaluation: Strong - Genuine understanding of year-end emotions and Grade 1 needs. Flexible approaches for different personality types and comfort levels. Real-world connections are developmentally appropriate and meaningful.
